title: chore: remove SlidePainter app
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes only the outdated `apps/slidepainter` application.
- Drops its deployment registration.
- Leaves all other applications and showcase records unchanged.
- Validated with Biome, JSON parsing, reference checks, and the deployment-consumer test.

Deployment note: the existing Cloudflare project or domain can be retired separately after merge.

gist.headline: Slides Leave the Garden
gist.blurb: SlidePainter has been gently packed away, along with its deployment registration. The rest of the app garden remains exactly where it was.
gist.summary: Removed the outdated apps/slidepainter application and its seven-entry deployment registration, leaving all other apps and showcase records unchanged.
gist.impact: The app roster is cleaner, while existing applications and showcase listings continue unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict SlidePainter as a cozy retired pixel-art slide projector and stack of presentation cards being carefully packed into a warm cream storage box. Polli, wearing a tiny archivist hat, labels the box beside healthy code-plants and an unchanged garden of small app icons, making the cleanup feel orderly rather than dramatic.
